1274 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
300 days before June 22, 1274:  
Back up 300 days = go back 9 months (approx 273 days) + 27 more days.  
June 22 → back 9 months → September 22, 1273.  
Back 27 more days from September 22, 1273: September has 30 days, so back 22 days → September 1, then back 5 more days → August 27, 1273.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1273-08-27
